PDF / DOCX to Markdown

Convert PDF and Word files to Markdown. Your files stay on your computer.
Once the page has loaded, it works without an internet connection.

    About

    No need to waste AI tokens converting PDF or Word files to Markdown. Convert them here first, then give the .md file to your AI tool.

    This tool runs entirely in your browser. Your files are never uploaded and nothing is stored. Once the page has loaded, it works without an internet connection.

    It works best with text-based PDFs and Word files. Scanned PDFs, two-column layouts and complex tables may need tidying by hand.

    Made by Subham Shrivastava.

    Built with open-source libraries: pdf.js (Mozilla), mammoth.js and Turndown.
